title: A Noise Sensitivity Exponent Controls Large Statistical-to-Computational Gaps in Single- and Multi-Index Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.17896v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Understanding when learning is statistically possible yet computationally hard is a central challenge in high-dimensional statistics. In this work, we investigate this question in the context of single- and multi-index models, classes of functions widely studied as benchmarks to probe the ability of machine learning methods to discover features in high-dimensional data. Our main contribution is to show that a Noise Sensitivity Exponent (NSE) - a simple quantity determined by the activation function - governs the existence and magnitude of statistical-to-computational gaps within a broad regime of these models. We first establish that, in single-index models with large additive noise, the onset of a computational bottleneck is fully characterized by the NSE. translated_title: 噪声敏感度指数控制单指标与多指标模型中的显著统计-计算差距
translated_abstract: 理解学习在统计上何时可行但在计算上却很困难，是高维统计中的一个核心挑战。在本工作中，我们在单指标和多指标模型的背景下研究这一问题，这两类函数被广泛研究，是探测机器学习方法在高维数据中发现特征能力的基准。我们的主要贡献是证明噪声敏感度指数（NSE）——一个由激活函数决定的简单量——在这些模型的广泛区域内支配统计-计算差距的存在性与大小。我们首先证明，在具有大加性噪声的单指标模型中，计算瓶颈的出现完全由NSE刻画。随后我们证明，同一指数控制着大型可分离多指标模型专业化转变中的统计-计算差距，其中个体……
tldr: 该论文提出由激活函数决定的噪声敏感度指数（NSE），证明这一简单量完全刻画并控制了单指标与多指标模型中大范围统计-计算差距的存在与大小。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Noise Sensitivity Exponent (NSE), a simple quantity determined by the activation function, and shows that it fully characterizes and governs the existence and magnitude of large statistical-to-computational gaps in single- and multi-index models.
